::: {#def-bca-acceleration}
#### Acceleration of the BCa interval

Let $\hat\theta_{(i)}$ be the statistic computed with observation $i$ deleted,
and let $\hat\theta_{(\cdot)}$ be the mean of
$\hat\theta_{(1)}, \ldots, \hat\theta_{(n)}$.
The **acceleration** is

$$\hat{a} \eqdef \frac{\sum_{i=1}^n \paren{\hat\theta_{(\cdot)} - \hat\theta_{(i)}}^3}
{6 \paren{\sum_{i=1}^n \paren{\hat\theta_{(\cdot)} - \hat\theta_{(i)}}^2}^{3/2}}.$$

:::
